opportunities.point: The company aims to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "From April onwards, from coming April onwards, our bids in the OMC tender would be as per our enhanced capacity and we are aiming to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that H2 numbers will be heavier than H1 numbers.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Our H2 numbers will be heavier than H1 numbers." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company received approvals for establishing two compressed biogas units in Rajasthan.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "As mentioned in our annual report also, for those who have missed the annual report or not gone through it, we have received approvals for establishing two compressed biogas units in the state of Rajasthan." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: Civil work for the compressed biogas project is expected to start by January end.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "By January end, we are looking to start the civil work of this compressed biogas project." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: A capex build-up is underway, pointing to future capacity.
opportunities.evidence: CWIP 0.75 Cr -> 1.69 Cr (125%) as of Mar 2026

opportunities.point: The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 12.6% earnings growth vs 41% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
The management noted that the indicative target of blending 5% biodiesel into diesel under the National Biofuels Policy creates a massive industry potential.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "As per National Biofuels Policy of 2018, there is an indicative target of blending 5% biodiesel into diesel. And seeing the target in line, it's a big, big, massive opportunity size in front of us." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that Europe has a 14% blending mandate across Europe for using biodiesel.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "If I talk about the European Union region, the demand is even higher as there is a 14% blending mandate across Europe for using biodiesel." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company has bid for the highest volume of biodiesel supply ever in its history in the current OMC biodiesel tender.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "I am very delighted to share that the current OMC's biodiesel tender for the period of November to March 2026 is out and really glad to share with you that we have bid the highest volume of biodiesel supply ever in our history." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.

threats.point: Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.

Management noted that pricing becomes a point of discussion during policy reviews, which cannot be resolved overnight.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The only thing is that sometimes in the review of policy, pricing becomes a point of discussion. And it is a subject which cannot be resolved overnight." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

Historically weak quarters (Sep) are still in the cycle.
